title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Commercial Account Tier Note — Day-Count Convention of the Payoff Accrual
content:
The interim payoff accrual on a Ridgeline Pro Credit commercial account is an annual figure — twelve times the monthly payoff accrual rate — applied to the accrued days, from the latest closed statement date to the payment date, expressed as a fraction of a year. The convention that turns the accrued days into that year fraction is set by the account's tier:

| Tier | Payoff accrual year fraction |
|---|---|
| Commercial Account Net 45 or Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise | The accrued days divided by 365 |
| Commercial Account Net 30 Select | The number of half-month periods begun in the accrued days, each half-month counted as one twenty-fourth of a year |
| Commercial Account Net 30 | The accrued days divided by 360 |

## Half-month periods on the Net 30 Select

A half-month period is 15 days, and a period counts as soon as it is begun: the number of periods is the accrued days divided by 15, rounded up to a whole number. That number is divided by 24.

| Accrued days | Half-month periods begun | Year fraction |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 1 | 1 | 1 twenty-fourth |
| 15 | 1 | 1 twenty-fourth |
| 16 | 2 | 2 twenty-fourths |
| 31 | 3 | 3 twenty-fourths |

## Worked comparison (hypothetical: past-due amount 6000.00, payoff accrual rate 1.50 percent, 20 accrued days)

The annual figure is 6000.00 times 1.50 divided by one hundred, times twelve, that is 1080.00.

- Net 45 or Net 60 Enterprise: 1080.00 times 20 divided by 365, 59.178082.
- Net 30 Select: 20 days begin 2 half-month periods, so 1080.00 times 2 divided by 24, 90.00.
- Net 30: 1080.00 times 20 divided by 360, 60.00.
